name: B10-0205/2024 (PPE) – The shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Cambodia's government to stop jailing, threatening and harassing activists, union members and journalists. It asks Cambodia to release detained activists, drop the charges against them and stop blocking independent media and civil society groups. It also asks the European Union to put more pressure on Cambodia, keep supporting local civil society groups, and make better human rights a condition for closer trade and investment.

- The EU is urged to pressure Cambodia to release activists and drop charges against groups like CENTRAL.
- Cambodia's government and its unions, activists and journalists are affected.
- The EU may link trade benefits to human rights and fund civil society groups.
